title: Comment "Sales" and I'll send you 1 month of Manychat Pro for free 👇 You can now connect ChatGPT
description: Comment "Sales" and I'll send you 1 month of Manychat Pro for free 👇 You can now connect ChatGPT directly to your Instagram and have it turn your comments into sales automatically. We're doing this through Manychat, the same tool every big creator uses to run their DMs, and it's approved by Meta so everything is completely safe. Here's how to set it up in 60 seconds: 1. Go to Manychat → Settings → Integrations 2. Scroll down and connect your ChatGPT account with an API key 3. To get the key: go to the OpenAI API website → API Keys → Create Secret Key 4. Copy it and paste it into Manychat Now inside Manychat, create a new automation, add an action block, select ChatGPT, choose your model, give it custom instructions, and set the automation live. Now when someone DMs you a question or comments on a post, ChatGPT handles the entire conversation on its own inside Instagram DMs and pushes them toward making a purchase. manychat #ManychatPartner
